today_summary: GCM26 marked $4,000.4 with 13 DTE, parked within $0.40 of the 4,998-contract put wall at $4,000 — the chain's pin and its last near-money floor. ATM IV 21.70% sets a 1σ daily envelope of $54.68 (1.37%). Net GEX in the ±$200 ATM band is −227.8, so dealers are short gamma where price actually sits and any break of $4,000 gets amplified, not absorbed. Session volume collapsed to 7,037 contracts (4,901 calls / 2,136 puts), the thinnest participation of the 5-day window.
five_day_thesis: The structural story of the last five sessions is a gamma regime inverting underneath a grinding $113.0 (−2.75%) slide from $4,113.4 to $4,000.4. Wide-window net GEX (±20% of spot) has bled from +306.9 to +35.8, an 88% collapse that leaves the stabilizing cushion all but gone, while the tight ±$200 ATM band went from −17.2 to −227.8 — 13× deeper short gamma precisely where price is trading. Meanwhile the walls never moved: put wall $3,700 (6,662 OI) and call wall $5,500 (16,547 OI) are unchanged 5 of 5 days, and P/C OI ratio has been frozen at 0.41 every single session, so this is spot migrating down through a static strike map, not a repositioning of the book. ATM IV compressed 1.32pp (23.02% → 21.70%) over the same slide — falling price with falling vol is distribution, not panic, and it has kept premium sellers paid. Volume halving from 13,482 to 7,037 contracts says the move down happened on absent flow, which makes the $4,000 shelf less defended than its 4,998 OI implies.

prediction: Bias neutral-bearish while $4,000 caps as resistance-turned-pivot. With −227.8 ATM GEX and 13 DTE, a sustained break below $4,000 accelerates into the $3,950 (4,125 put OI, −49.6 net GEX) and $3,900 (6,529 put OI, −76.3 net GEX) gamma nodes rather than stalling there.
